# documented global flags (README Global Flags table)

# --json flag
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --json version
stdout '"version"'

# --quiet flag
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --quiet version

# --no-color and --no-input flags (already used above, but validate explicitly)
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --help
stdout 'Discover, load, publish, and manage agent bundles'
